key_insight: recAMPLIFY reuses a weight-tied Transformer core to improve protein predictions with 56% fewer unique parameters than AMPLIFY-350M.
engineering_relevance: Adjustable recurrence offers a way to trade inference compute for predictive quality without increasing unique parameter count.
method: Recursively refine residue-aligned hidden states in a masked protein language model.
Use Gated Mixture Recurrence to decode a probability-weighted mixture of states across cycles.
Learn residual gates that control how much each cycle updates the hidden state.
evidence_signal: With 155M unique parameters and the same 2T training tokens as AMPLIFY-350M, recAMPLIFY improves CASP contact recovery and 3 of 4 supervised tasks, including a reported 22.5% increase in fold accuracy.
watch_item: Optimal recurrence depth varies by task and assay; GMR reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, but accuracy trade-offs are task-dependent.
paper_title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
